title: Hellfire Peninsula
body: Hellfire Peninsula is a red and broken waste, one of the fragments of Draenor that survived the day Ner'zhul tore the world apart with his portals, drained of life long before by the warlocks of the old Horde. At its heart stands Hellfire Citadel, once the Horde's great stronghold, and for twenty years the Sons of Lothar have held out at Honor Hold. Now the Dark Portal has woken again: the Legion pours in under Doom Lord Kazzak, and the citadel spills out the red-skinned orcs of a new Fel Horde.

title: The Stair of Destiny
body: On the Outland side of the Dark Portal a vast stair descends to the plain, and at its foot the armies of Azeroth, Alliance and Horde side by side, hold the gate against the Legion's waves. From the gates of Hellfire Citadel to the foot of the stair runs the Path of Glory, and the orcs who named it paved it with the bones of the draenei they slaughtered.

title: Honor Hold
body: Honor Hold is the last bastion of the Sons of Lothar, survivors of the Alliance expedition who have held this keep for twenty years behind walls the fel orcs have battered and broken. Force Commander Danath Trollbane, nephew of Stromgarde's king, has led them since Draenor was torn apart and his friends were lost to the void, praying for the day the portal would open. Now it has, and the reinforcements have brought fresh hope, and grim news from home.

parts.body: The old priest of the hold once gave Turalyon his book of the Light, and through all the years of the campaign Turalyon read the day's passage to his men. Returned from the ruins, it is the only token of him left.

title: Thrallmar
body: Thrallmar is the Horde's foothold in Outland, caught between Hellfire Citadel and the Legion's camps on the ridges behind it. It is commanded by Nazgrel, one of the orcs Thrall freed from the internment camps, who behind his ragged wolf mask would follow his warchief through the gates of the abyss. Thrall hopes to find the true tale of the orcish people in the wreckage of Draenor, and in his darkest moments Nazgrel fears that tale is better left untold.

title: Hellfire Citadel
body: Hellfire Citadel was the stronghold of the old Horde, the staging ground from which its armies marched against the draenei. The Alliance tore down its walls twenty years ago, yet now it is the heart of a new Fel Horde: each day its gates open and more red-skinned fel orcs pour out, and how so many have come to be is a secret the fortress still keeps.

title: Expedition Armory
body: South of Honor Hold lie the ruins of the Expedition Armory, a Sons of Lothar base that fell near the end of the Alliance invasion of Draenor. Orcs and Horde death knights stormed it, and the death knights laid a curse on its defenders that trapped their souls between life and death. They are the Unyielding, footmen, knights and sorcerers who still fight the battle they lost, and few in Honor Hold will speak of the place.

parts.body: A tome carried by one of the ghosts holds the armory's whole history, even what came after its fall: the Unyielding remain as vengeful spirits, locked in an endless battle with the fel orc clans.

title: The Forge Camps
body: Along the northern ridges above Thrallmar the Legion's engineers have raised a line of forge camps, where mo'arg overseers drive gan'arg servants to build fel reavers, the towering war engines that already stride across the peninsula. Behind them rises the Abyssal Shelf, the Legion's main production grounds, and to the east its front runs across the plain with portals drawing in reinforcements, facing two forward bases of soldiers sworn to wipe the Legion out entirely.

parts.body: Legion missives from the camps name the demon who commands its ground forces here: Arazzius the Cruel, one of Kazzak's lieutenants, massing terrorfiends at the Pools of Aggonar.

title: Throne of Kil'jaeden
body: The Throne of Kil'jaeden is a great mountain on the northern edge of the peninsula, and the orcs' histories tie it to the warlock Gul'dan and the demon lord whose name it bears. Today it is the seat of Doom Lord Kazzak, master of the Legion's armies in Outland, who gathered its remnants in the Blasted Lands after Hyjal and passed through the reopened portal, still nursing the sting of the Third War.

parts.body: A gateway on the mountain once carried Prince Kael'thas's armies to the Sunwell, and it is the road by which the Legion still reinforces Quel'Danas; the Shattered Sun keeps blowing it apart.

title: Temple of Telhamat
body: On the western frontier stands the Temple of Telhamat, one of the few draenei holy places to survive. When Velen led his people away, some chose to stay and keep the sacred sites, and here the blind elder Amaan the Wise leads them; they call themselves the Omenai. Broken who escaped the Illidari shelter here too, and the anchorites work to cleanse the Pools of Aggonar to the east, sacred springs fouled by a demon's blood.

parts.body: A young paladin of the temple, Sedai, went to make peace with the orcs and was found slain by a blow to the back. A vision at his body leaves the truth unclear, and Amaan asks only that the old feud be met with an open mind.

title: Mag'har Post
body: In the hills northwest of Hellfire Citadel, hidden from the fel orcs who would destroy it, lies Mag'har Post, a camp of brown-skinned orcs who never drank the demon's blood. These are the Mag'har, the uncorrupted, and their captain Gorkan Bloodfist keeps the camp's location secret at any cost. The draenei of Telhamat remember these orcs as enemies.

parts.body: Told that the son of Durotan rules a free Horde beyond the Dark Portal, untouched by the demons' taint, Gorkan sent word to Nagrand at once: Hellscream must hear of it.

title: Falcon Watch
body: Falcon Watch is the newly built outpost of the blood elves in the southwest of the peninsula, a resting place for the pilgrims who cross Outland in search of Prince Kael'thas, many of whom arrive exhausted and starved for magic. Its people are ambitious: they harvest demonic felblood from the Pools of Aggonar, covet the magic of the arakkoa and test demonic essences on a captive draenei.

title: Fallen Sky Ridge
body: North of the Cenarion Expedition's post on the road to Zangarmarsh rises Fallen Sky Ridge. At its center a huge red crystal juts from the ground. It fell from the sky not long ago, shaking the land, and soon after the ridge filled with raging colossi that had never been seen here before. The druids sense a sickly evil flowing from it, but it is too large to move and beyond their power to destroy.

parts.body: The crystal is no falling star: it was dropped on the ridge by the servants of Prince Kael'thas, Pathaleon the Calculator behind it, and its emanations summon the giants and drive them mad.
